overview_description.description: SOKNA offers an end-to-end funeral service that helps in honoring the lives of departed loved ones. Its services include burial permits and paperwork, body preparation, and cemetery setup, transportation, hall booking, obituaries, Sadaqah Jariyah and giveaways, and repatriation. The company also sells high-end coffins, individualized souvenirs, and floral tributes.
